title: Aunt Picky
sources: Chant 3  P.49  Aunt Picky.mp3
text:
Aunt Picky wants a pumpkin.
“Oh, which one will I buy?
The big one? The small one?
The fat one? The tall one?
I just can’t decide!”
“Is this one as good as that one?
It’s better than the fat one.
It’s bigger than the next one.
Oh, which one is the best one?!”
She looks and thinks… And thinks and looks…
And there in front of her eyes,
She sees the best of all the pumpkins
To put into her pie!
“Look, lady, which one do you want?”
Asks the pumpkin man.
“I need to go home as soon as I can.”
Aunt Picky frowns and cries a lot.
“I’m sorry,” she says, “but I forgot.”

a) _What are your family doing in the winter holiday? ______

The best job for someone. (‘I like’ + ‘I’m good at…’)

b) I like painting and I’m good at working hard. What job can I have? (pointer and

  At least 8 sentences- opening, 6-8 content sentences, closing   
You need an opening and closing sentence (examples are in bold) and 6 content sentences. 
You can add up to 2 more content sentences. 
‘What are you and your classmates doing next week? What aren’t you doing?’  
1. I’m going to tell you about what me and my classmates are doing next week. 
2. We are all students so next week we are all coming to school… 
3. …and doing our homework everyday. 
4. On Monday, I am also going to dance class.  
5. I often go to art class on Tuesday but next week I am going on Wednesday. 
6. My classmate, Tommy, isn’t going to art class on Wednesday. 
7. He is going on Thursday because he doesn’t have time on Wednesday. 
8. Another of my classmates, Judy, is taking part in a swimming competition on Friday. 
9. She is very good at swimming. 
10. This is what me and my classmates are doing next week. 
‘What are you and your family doing at the weekend? What aren’t you doing?’  
1. Here is what me and my family are doing this weekend. 
2. I am finishing my homework on Saturday morning 
3. …then I’m going to the park with my brother 
4. My mum is going to her tennis class on Saturday morning.

5. …so my dad is cooking lunch for us. 
6. On Sunday we are all going to the museum together. 
7. I want to see the dinosaurs there. 
8. That is what me and my family are doing this weekend. 
‘What are you and your friends doing after school? What aren’t you doing?’  
1. This is what me and my friends are doing after school. 
2. We are all students so after school we are all doing homework. 
3. We are not going to the park after school. 
4. After I finish my homework, I’m having dinner… 
5. …then I’m watching TV until I go to bed. 
6. One of my friends, Sally is going to her football club after school. 
7. She plays football every week. 
8. This is what me and my family are doing this weekend.

text:

There lived a boy named Jack.

He was a good boy, but he was forgetful.

Bye, Mom.

Two tomatoes and milk.

We're going to ride our bikes.

Oh, you're so cute.

Do you want to hold him?

Jack, I said five lemons and a can of soup.

Jack, can you run to the supermarket for me?

Sure, Dad.

We need some chicken soup and orange juice.

Jack did not want to forget this time.

Chicken soup and orange juice.

Red roses.

Beautiful red roses.

Jack, don't forget what to buy.

Chicken soup and orange juice.

Jack walked quickly.

Hey, Jack.

Let's go skateboarding.

Hi, Jack.

Come inside and see the puppy.

No, thank you.

I have to go.

This time I didn't forget what to buy.

Red roses.

Beautiful red roses.

Oh, Mother would love these roses.

Tomato soup and ice cream.

Jack.

You forgot again.

What are you hiding behind your back?

I'm sorry.

I always forget.

What are those roses for?

Roses? How did you know I wanted roses?

I heard you.

So you didn't forget the most important thing.

Here is what I want you to buy, Jack.

Now I will never forget what to buy.

title: The Donkey and the Lapdog
sources: KIDS' STORIES/09 曲目 9.wma
四上英语录音包/KIDS' STORIES/09 曲目 9.wma
text:
The donkey and the lap dog.

Once upon a time, there was a big farm.

On this farm lived a donkey, a lap dog and their master.

The farmer was very fond of his lap dog.

The dog knew many tricks.

He made the farmer laugh.

The donkey worked very hard for his master.

He wanted to please a farmer.

But the farmer did not notice.

I wish I didn't have to work so hard, said the donkey.

The dog does nothing, but the farmer still loves him.

One day, the donkey decided he wanted to quit being a donkey.

I am going to be just like the dog, said the donkey.

Then the farmer will love me as much as he loves the dog.

The donkey ran into his master's house.

He tried to remember what the dog did.

The donkey tried to chase his tail like the dog.

Then he jumped up and down like the dog.

The donkey jumped up and landed on the farmer's lap.

Then he licked the farmer's face, just like the dog.

The donkey waited for the farmer to come and pet him on the head, or give him a special treat.

But instead of a treat, the donkey got a big surprise.

What a crazy donkey!

Shouted the farmer as he smacked the donkey on its head.

From that day on, the farmer made the donkey work harder and harder.

I'm so miserable, cried the donkey.

Why did I ever want to be like the dog?

He wailed.

It is better to be happy with what you have than to take something you are not fit to receive.

text:
A visit to the zoo.

Andy went to the park early.

He had two bananas, a pear, and a bag of peanuts.

The food was for Bongo, the monkey he helped rescue from the animal shelter.

Bongo was living in a tall oak tree in the park.

When he saw Andy with the food, he quickly climbed down.

He ate the bananas, then he ate the pear.

Andy kept the peanuts for later.

A voice shouted from behind him, hey, Andy.

It was Tommy with his sister, Sam.

Lucy and Kim followed close behind.

Is RK-5 with you?

asked Andy.

Of course I am, said a voice from Tommy's pocket.

Tommy gently pulled the little robot from his pocket.

Everyone was talking at the same time, including Bongo.

Bongo says he wants to find some monkey friends at the zoo, said RK-5.

They all agreed it would be fun to go to the zoo.

They would find some friends for Bongo.

Andy put Bongo in his backpack.

They didn't want anyone at the zoo to see Bongo.

The zookeeper might want to keep him at the zoo.

Tommy pressed 26, 15, 15, X, 6 on the buttons on RK-5.

There was a flash of blue light and thick smoke.

When the smoke cleared, they found themselves on a hill.

There were pink flamingos all around them.

Look, there's a path there, said Kim.

There's a sign which shows where all the animals are, said Tommy.

They ran to the sign to find out where the monkeys lived.

Lucy pointed to a picture of the monkey house on the sign.

Kim said, here's Flamingo Hill.

That's where we are now.

If we walk to the end of this path and turn left, we'll be at the monkey house, said Tommy.

They all ran off to visit the monkeys.

They didn't see Sam stop to look at the crocodiles.

Sam counted three big crocodiles.

They all had lots of big, scary teeth.

Suddenly, a gust of wind blew Sam's hat off.

It went into the crocodile pen.

No, she said out loud.

I'm not going in there to get my hat.

I'll find the zookeeper.

He'll get my hat for me.

Tommy and the others found the monkey house.

Andy let Bongo out of the backpack.

Bongo had a fine time chatting with his new monkey friends.

Everybody laughed at the funny faces the monkeys made.

Where's Sam, asked Kim.

They all looked around.

Oh no, she's lost, said Tommy.

Now I'm in super big trouble.

They ran back towards Flamingo Hill.

They passed the crocodile pen.

Andy shouted, look, there's Sam's hat.

It's in the crocodile pen.

Sam's been eaten by a crocodile.

Kim started crying.

The others looked very scared.

Hey, look at me, said a voice behind them.

It was Sam.

She was with the zookeeper.

He had a long pole with a hook on the end.

He used the pole to get Sam's hat from the crocodile pen.

They said thank you to the zookeeper.

I'm hungry, said Sam.

It must be time for lunch.

It is 11:30 AM, said RK-5.

In 30 minutes, it will be time for your lunch.

We'd better go, said Tommy.

Now that we have RK-5, we can come back to the zoo any time.

title: The Weather
sources: KIDS' STORIES/11 曲目 11.wma
四上英语录音包/KIDS' STORIES/11 曲目 11.wma
text:
The weather.

The weather is important to us.

It affects the way we live, what we eat, and what we wear.

It even affects the way we feel.

Rainbow, when the sun comes out after a rain shower, you might see a rainbow in the sky.

As the sun's light shines through raindrops, it splits up into colors.

The colors of the rainbow always appear in the same order.

Red is at the top, then orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet at the bottom.

Snowflake.

If you look at a snowflake through a magnifying glass, you might see some of these crystals.

Most crystals have six sides.

You will never find two with the exact same pattern.

Next time it snows, catch some snowflakes and count the different patterns you see.

Lightning and thunder.

Lightning and thunder happen at the same time, but you always see the lightning first.

This is because light travels much, much faster than sound.

Meteorologists are people who study the weather.

Forecasters are people who tell us what the weather will be like.

Weather forecasts.

Tell farmers if it is a good time to plant or harvest their crops.

Warn sailors at sea if a storm is coming.

Let us know if it will rain.

That's useful to know if you're going out.

Tell us if it is going to snow so we can dress warmly.

Meteorologists and weather forecasters measure things like the wind, temperature, the amount of water vapor in the air, air pressure, and rainfall.

They use these instruments.

A barometer measures air pressure.

A thermometer measures temperature.

A windsock shows which ways the wind is blowing.

A rain gauge measures rainfall.

An anemometer measures wind speed.

text:
Little Mermaid.

Long, long ago, in the deepest ocean, the sea king had seven beautiful mermaids.

The youngest was the prettiest, and she had the loveliest voice.

When the Little Mermaid was 15 years old, she was allowed to swim up to the surface of the sea.

She saw a young prince on a large ship.

Soon, a dreadful storm came, and the ship was broken.

The prince sank into the deep waves and fainted.

The Little Mermaid helped him and took him to the beach.

But a young girl came.

The Little Mermaid hid herself between some high rocks.

The prince came to life again.

He didn't remember the Little Mermaid.

He left with that girl.

The Little Mermaid was so sad.

I know what you want, said the sea witch.

You want to have two legs instead of your tail, right?

I can help you.

Drink this draught, and then you can have legs.

But you will feel great pain when you walk.

And if you do not win the love of the prince, you will become the foam of the waves.

I will do it, said the Little Mermaid.

But you must give your sweet voice to me, said the witch.

It shall be, said the Little Mermaid.

After she drank the draught, she became dumb, would never again speak or sing.

Then she saw the handsome young prince again.

He took her to the palace.

Very soon, the prince wanted to marry the beautiful princess, who saved his life on the beach.

The Little Mermaid's sister, the Little Mermaid's sisters, gave her a knife.

Before the sun rises, you must kill the prince, and you will be a mermaid again, they told the Little Mermaid.

But the Little Mermaid didn't want to kill the prince.

She threw herself into the sea, and her body changed into foam.

title: King Arthur
sources: KIDS' STORIES/13 曲目 13.wma
四上英语录音包/KIDS' STORIES/13 曲目 13.wma
text:
King Arthur.

The story of King Arthur is one that has been told for hundreds of years.

There have been poems, books, and even films made of his life, all of them telling the story a little differently.

The basic story is this.

There was a sword stuck in a stone.

The legend said that whoever could remove the sword would become King of England and save the country.

Many brave knights tried to pull the sword out, but they failed.

One day, a young boy called Arthur was walking past the stone.

He didn't know it, but he was in fact the son of an old king.

He pulled the sword out of the stone and became the new king of England.

The stories of Arthur as king are tales of bravery and nobility.

His closest advisor was Merlin, a powerful wizard.

Arthur lived in a castle called Camelot with his beautiful wife, Guinevere.

In the castle, he had a round table where he sat with his knights.

It was round so that there was no one at the head of the table, which is where the most important person would usually sit.

And Arthur and his knights were all equal.

Arthur, with his famous magical sword Excalibur and his closest knights, Sir Lancelot and Sir Galahad, fought against the forces of evil in England.

These were led by Arthur's half-sister, Morgan, who was a witch.

After many battles, there was only one left to fight.

Arthur and his knights finally won the battle against Morgan's army, and England was safe.

However, Arthur had been hurt and was dying.

He threw his sword into a lake where the magical lady of the lake could look after it, and then he died.

He was buried in Avalon in the southwest of England.

According to the legend, Arthur will rise again to save England if it is ever in danger in the future.

But did Arthur really exist?

Some say he was a Roman.

Others say a Briton fighting the invading Saxons.

But there is no proof of his existence.

But perhaps this doesn't matter.

The story of a great, noble and brave king who died to save his country is one that people of all generations find fascinating, even today.

Mid-Revision III Reading and Answering
Class______ No.______ Name_____
A Busy Saturday
Last Saturday, Jack got up early and made breakfast for his family. Then he
helped his mom clean the room and water the plants. In the afternoon, he cooked
dinner together with his dad. They made pasta with tomato sauce. After dinner, Jack
did the dishes and fed his pet dog. His little sister helped him sweep the floor. Jack
was very tired, but he was happy, because he helped his family a lot. His mom said,
"You are a helpful boy!" On Sunday, Jack made a gift for his grandma and took it to
her home. It was a busy weekend, but Jack learned that doing chores together makes
the family happy.

——————————————————————————————————
2. What did Jack and his dad do in the afternoon?

3. What chores did Jack do last weekend? (At least 2)

My Best Friend
My best friend is Lily. She is eleven years old. She is tall and thin, and she has
long hair and big eyes. She is kind and quiet, but she is friendlier than me. Lily is
smarter than I am, and I am faster than she is. We are different, but we get along very
well. We often read books together in the library, and we play games after school.
Sometimes she helps me with Chinese, and I help her with math. On Fridays, we play
football on the playground with our classmates. I like Lily because she is kind and
always helps me. A friend in need is a friend indeed. I hope we can be good friends
forever.
1.What does Lily look like? (3')
—————————————————————————————————
2.What do the writer and Lily often do together? (3')
——————————————————————————————————
3.How are the writer and Lily different? (At least 2) (4')
——————————————————————————————————

A Walk in Our Community
Our community is big and beautiful. There is a park, a library, a supermarket and
a gym in it. Last Sunday, the weather was sunny, so Nina and her father took a walk
in the park. They saw many people doing sports there. Her mother went to the
supermarket to go shopping. In the afternoon, Nina went to the library with her father.
She read books about animals there, because she thinks reading is important. On their
way home, they saw the bus stop near the shop. Nina loves her community. She says,
"There are many useful places near my home, and the people here are kind. I often see
my neighbors and say hello to them."
1.Where did Nina and her father go last Sunday? (3')
——————————————————————————————————
2.What did Nina do in the library? (3')
——————————————————————————————————
3.What places are there in Nina's community? (At least 2) (4')

Fresh Food from Our Garden
Our class has a small school garden. Every student loves it. Last month, we dug
the soil and planted some seeds — tomatoes, cucumbers and green beans. We have to
water the garden three times a week, and we weed it every Friday. We also pick out
the small stones and take care of the plants every day. Now the plants are growing
well. Last week, we picked some fresh tomatoes and lettuce. Our teacher cooked a big
bowl of vegetable soup for us. It was delicious! We learned that fresh food is good for
us, and growing vegetables is fun but not easy. Now we never waste food, because we
know how hard it is to grow it.

——————————————————————————————————

3. What did the class pick last week? (At least 2) (4')

The Same and Different
Amy and her cousin Mike look like twins, but they are different in many ways.
Mike is older and taller than Amy. Amy is smaller, but she runs faster than Mike.
Amy has wavy hair and she inherited it from her mother. Mike has straight hair, just
like his father. Last week, they learned about family traits in science class. The
teacher showed them their earlobes: Amy has attached earlobes, and Mike has
unattached earlobes. Mike can fold his tongue, but Amy can't. They found it very
interesting! Amy thinks family traits are like a special gift from our family. Now she
wants to learn more about her relatives and find more similarities and differences.

A Hero Next Door
Uncle Ben is a firefighter. He works in the fire station near our community.
Every day, he gets up early and checks his big red truck. When there is a fire, he hears
the siren and drives the truck very fast. Firefighters put out fires and save people.
Sometimes people are trapped in a burning building, and Uncle Ben goes in and helps
them get out. He also helps people when they have accidents or get sick. Last month,
he visited our school and taught us how to be safe in a fire. "Do not hide. Shout for
help and get out fast," he said. Uncle Ben is a hero to me, because his job is dangerous,
but he is brave and helpful. I want to be a hero like him one day.

A Happy Friday
Last Friday was a special day for Class Four. The students went to the old
people's home near the school with their teacher. They wanted to do something for the
old people there. In the morning, the girls cleaned the rooms and made the beds. The
boys watered the flowers in the small garden. At noon, they helped the cooks make
dumplings, and everyone ate lunch together. In the afternoon, Anna sang an old song,
and Mike told a funny story. The old people laughed and clapped their hands.
Grandma Li said, "You are like my grandchildren. Thank you for coming." The
students were tired but very happy. They learned that helping other people can make
everyone happy, and they want to visit again next month.

Tom had a very busy day yesterday. He was very hungry in the morning, so he
ate three eggs and a big bowl of noodles. At school, he felt sleepy in the first class,
because he went to bed late the night before. After lunch, he played football with his
friends on the playground, and he felt excited. But in the afternoon, he was bored in
the music class, because the song was too long. After school, he could not find his
schoolbag. He was scared, so he shouted for help. His friend Jack came and helped
him. The schoolbag was under the desk! Tom felt much better. At night, he was very
tired, so he took a nap before dinner. "What a day!" he said to his mother.

Wind: I am stronger than you, Sun.
Sun: No way! I am stronger than you, and I will show you.
Sun: Do you see that man down there? Can you make him take off his coat?
Wind: Of course I can.
Man: Oh, it's cold.
Sun: The man didn't take off his coat.
Man: Gee, it's even colder.
Sun: Ha ha! He still has his coat on.
Wind: Okay, now you try.
Man: Oh, strange. It's getting warmer now.
Wind: See? The man still has his coat on.
Sun: Just wait. You'll see.
Man: Oh, now it's hot.
Sun: See? I did it. I did it. The man took off his coat.
